package rulefixtures

import (
	"slices"
)

// scenario for repeated_slice_clone_in_loop: slices.Clone(...) or similar whole-slice cloning observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
func scenario362Positive(source []int, rounds int) [][]int {
	var results [][]int
	for i := 0; i < rounds; i++ {
		clone := slices.Clone(source)
		clone = append(clone, i)
		results = append(results, clone)
	}
	return results
}
